name: gitlab-babysit-mr
description: Monitor a GitLab MR's pipeline until green. Classifies failures (flaky, master-broken, lint, coverage, real), retries jobs where appropriate, makes light-touch auto-fixes, and posts findings as an MR comment.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor a GitLab MR's pipeline until green.
interface.longDescription: Monitors a GitLab merge request's CI pipeline until it reaches a green state. The skill classifies each failure as flaky, master-broken, a lint error, a coverage drop, or a genuine regression, then takes the appropriate action: retrying transient jobs, applying light-touch code fixes, or posting a structured findings report as a resolved discussion thread on the MR. Use this skill when you want to hand off pipeline-watching and triage to the agent so you can focus on other work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the gitlab-babysit-mr skill for this task.
